episodeTitle.en: What AI means for your product strategy | Paul Adams (CPO of Intercom)
episodeTitle.zh: 人工智能对您产品战略意味着什么？ | 保罗·亚当斯（Intercom首席产品官）

guestBioOfficial.en: Paul Adams is the longtime chief product officer at Intercom, where he leads the product management, product design, data science, and research teams. Before Intercom, Paul was the global head of brand design at Facebook, a senior user researcher at Google, and a product designer at Dyson. He’s also a best-selling author, a podcast host, and a public speaker. In today’s episode, we discuss: • Practical advice on integrating AI into your organization
guestBioOfficial.zh: 保罗·亚当斯长期担任Intercom的首席产品官，负责领导产品管理、产品设计、数据科学和研究团队。在加入Intercom之前，保罗曾担任Facebook全球品牌设计主管、谷歌高级用户研究员，以及Dyson的产品设计师。他还是畅销书作家、播客主持人和公众演说家。在本期节目中，我们将探讨：• 将人工智能融入组织的实用建议

title.en: What AI means for your product strategy | Paul Adams (CPO of Intercom)
title.zh: 人工智能对您产品战略意味着什么？ | 保罗·亚当斯（Intercom首席产品官）

summary.en: Paul shares candid stories of professional failure - including freezing on stage at Cannes - and argues that failure is essential experience for product leaders. He goes deep on Intercom's all-in embrace of AI, explaining why leaders must move from fear and noise to actively trying the technology, and draws parallels to the mobile shift a decade ago. The episode blends personal vulnerability with sharp advice on building craft-focused, AI-native products.
summary.zh: Paul 坦诚分享了自己职业中的失败经历——包括在戛纳演讲时当众卡壳——并主张失败是产品领导者必不可少的历练。他深入讲解了 Intercom 全面拥抱 AI 的历程，解释领导者为何必须从恐惧与喧嚣转向真正动手尝试这项技术，并与十年前的移动化浪潮作了类比。本期将个人的脆弱坦诚与关于打造注重工艺、AI 原生产品的犀利建议结合在一起。
